title: Are there dedicated times or spaces for silent reflection, rest and personal practice (sadhana)?

segments.text: The entire Ashaeiynn is your home and with our flexible schedule, you are free to pause, rest, or step away whenever you need to. If you are feeling tired or simply want a quiet moment to yourself, you can rest in the Tapa room or ask any volunteer to guide you to a suitable resting area. ​You are free to do your individual sadhana anywhere on the grounds or inside the hall. However, since you have taken precious time out of your busy life to be here, we strongly encourage you to do your mantra chanting in the havan area near Parikshit Bhaiya. Since mantra chanting can be done anywhere, sitting in Bhaiya's presence allows you to absorb his energy, insights, and spiritual knowledge while you practice, maximizing every moment of your stay.
